CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2659 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 5c091c198bb3d4663df171b918ecc80eb415428b. Bus nonce: 211ac2c587dfe2b241422fc70d02c834. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 5c091c198bb3d4663df171b918ecc80eb415428b`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 5c091c198bb3d4663df171b918ecc80eb415428b` or `Fix review: blocked 5c091c198bb3d4663df171b918ecc80eb415428b <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 211ac2c587dfe2b241422fc70d02c834`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `5c091c198bb3d4663df171b918ecc80eb415428b` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2659 5c091c198bb3d4663df171b918ecc80eb415428b") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2659-211ac2c5`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2659, group R10-FLY-SUITE-ENV-FLAKES, head 5c091c198bb3d4663df171b918ecc80eb415428b. Read the group with jq from origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Use the finder harness the group brief names, never the fixer harness. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.

The change: tests/harness_headers.py skips ONLY its CPU-headroom grade when HPO_CLOSURE_RECORDING=1 (closure.py sets it while recording a script under strace). It still runs every harness and checks its exit.

Verify:
(1) Red first (50423394a), then the fix (5576bcdba). Mutant: drop the flag check, and show the recorded-run pin goes red. Plant: inflate a harness cost past half its bound, giving rc 1 without the flag and rc 0 with it.
(2) NULL, the key claim: an unrecorded run past half its bound still FAILS. Confirm the fast lane (no strace) runs harness_headers WITHOUT HPO_CLOSURE_RECORDING on every PR, by reading the workflow and closure.py, so no grade is lost.
(3) The flag cannot leak: check that nothing except closure.py's recording path sets HPO_CLOSURE_RECORDING (git grep), and that a stray env in CI cannot disable the grade on the fast lane.
(4) The skip skips nothing else: harness exit codes and the other header checks still grade under the flag.
(5) The 50% rule and the 240 s bound are unchanged (diff).
(6) Scoped gate MODE line; CI read with one bulk check-runs read; no footers in commits; VERSION untouched.
